power.method: PoE (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30 W, heater unpowered), Bosch 60 W midspan, or 24 VAC

storage.notes: Full-size SD card slot (max 2 TB); microSD not recommended.

features: High dynamic range 120 dB (100 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Open camera platform with apps from the Security & Safety Things store
Turbo pan 400 deg/s, tilt 300 deg/s; normal 0.1-120 deg/s
Indoor in-ceiling mount, tinted bubble, plenum rated
ONVIF Profile S, G and T
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDP_7602_Z30CT_Data_sheet_enUS_84741843467.pdf). CT = in-ceiling, tinted bubble. Power consumption 19.2 W typical without heaters. Sensitivity at F1.6, 30 IRE. Platform CPP13. Datasheet V6, Mar 2021.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
